evals.prompt: Make a plain HTML play/pause toggle button where the icon morphs. No build step.
evals.expected: Script tag https://shapcn.com/morph-icon.js, <morph-icon name=play>, name changes to pause on click, aria-label on button, aria-hidden on icon.

evals.prompt: In my React app add a theme switch button where the sun morphs into a moon with a spring feel.
evals.expected: <morph-icon name={dark?'moon':'sun'} easing="spring">, aria-label on button, element defined only in browser, installs shape-aware-morph from npm (or uses the script tag).

evals.prompt: I have my own SVG icon (a star). Make it morph into a lucide heart.
evals.expected: registerSVGs on npm path, or window.shapcn.registerIcons with nodes on script path; lucide heart name is 'heart'.

evals.prompt: Add a hover effect to the icons in my nav bar so they grow a little on hover. Plain HTML.
evals.expected: Script tag, <morph-icon name=... hover="grow"> inside a link or button, aria-label on the control, aria-hidden on the icon, no invented hover names.

evals.prompt: Make my delete button burst and turn into a check mark when clicked.
evals.expected: <morph-icon name="trash" press="burst"> and icon.pressTo('check') in the click handler (or setting name during the press), aria-label on the button, no keyframes.
